27	class ClientRegistry:

30	    def __init__(self):

46	        with self._lock:

64	        self.type = msg_type

86	class NotificationServer:
87	    """WebSocket notification server with broadcast capability."""

89	    def __init__(self, host: str = "127.0.0.1", ws_port: int = 8765, http_port: int = 8080):
90	        self.host = host
91	        self.ws_port = ws_port
92	        self.http_port = http_port

96	    async def handle_client(self, websocket: ServerConnection) -> None:
97	        """Handle a connected WebSocket client."""
98	        client_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
99	        self.clients.add(client_id, websocket)
100	
101	        logger.info(f"Client {client_id} connected. Total clients: {self.clients.count()}")
102	
103	        try:
104	            system_msg = NotificationMessage(
105	                "system",
106	                {"action": "connected", "client_id": client_id}
107	            )

109

112	                    msg = NotificationMessage.from_json(message)
113	                    logger.info(f"Received from {client_id}: {msg.type}")
114	
115	                    if msg.type == "broadcast":
116	                        await self.broadcast(
117	                            NotificationMessage("broadcast", msg.payload)
118	                        )
119	                    elif msg.type == "direct":

123	                    elif msg.type == "system":

134	        except websockets.exceptions.ConnectionClosed:

27	class ClientRegistry:
28	    """Thread-safe registry of connected WebSocket clients with channel support."""

30	    def __init__(self):

36	        """Add a client to the registry."""
37	        with self._lock:
38	            self._clients[client_id] = connection
39	            self._subscriptions[client_id] = set()
40	
41	    def remove(self, client_id: str) -> None:
42	        """Remove a client from the registry."""
43	        with self._lock:
44	            self._clients.pop(client_id, None)
45	            self._subscriptions.pop(client_id, None)
46	
47	    def get(self, client_id: str) -> ServerConnection | None:
48	        """Get a client connection by ID."""
49	        with self._lock:
50	            return self._clients.get(client_id)
51	
52	    def get_all(self) -> Dict[str, ServerConnection]:
53	        """Get a copy of all clients."""
54	        with self._lock:
55	            return dict(self._clients)

58	        """Get the number of connected clients."""
59	        with self._lock:

62	    def subscribe(self, client_id: str, channel: str) -> None:
63	        """Subscribe a client to a channel."""
64	        with self._lock:
65	            if client_id in self._subscriptions:
66	                self._subscriptions[client_id].add(channel)

69	        """Unsubscribe a client from a channel."""

71	            if client_id in self._subscriptions:
72	                self._subscriptions[client_id].discard(channel)

144	            system_msg = NotificationMessage(
145	                "system",

147	            )
148	            await websocket.send(system_msg.to_json())
149	
150	            async for message in websocket:
151	                try:
152	                    msg = NotificationMessage.from_json(message)
153	                    logger.info(f"Received from {client_id}: {msg.type}")
154	
155	                    if msg.type == "subscribe":
156	                        channel = msg.payload.get("channel")
157	                        if channel:

182	                except json.JSONDecodeError as e:
